gloss: scar; mark left by a wound

definitions.gloss: scar; mark left by a wound or injury
definitions.explanation: A physical mark remaining on the skin or a surface after a wound has healed. Also used figuratively for lasting emotional damage or evidence of past destruction.

examples.japanese: ⟦{腕|うで}→腕：01006_ude⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{傷跡|きずあと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}っている→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: There is a scar on my arm.

examples.japanese: ⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{傷跡|きずあと}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦だんだん→だんだん：00832_dandan⟧⟦{目立|めだ}たなく→目立つ：02431_medatsu⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The surgical scar gradually became less noticeable.

examples.japanese: ⟦{戦争|せんそう}→戦争：01450_sensou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{傷跡|きずあと}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{街|まち}→街：17306_machi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦あちこち→あちこち：01687_achikochi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{残|のこ}っている→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: The scars of war still remain throughout the city.

notes:
{傷跡|きずあと} is a compound of ⟦{傷|きず}→傷：02201_kizu⟧ (wound) and ⟦{跡|あと}→跡：02174_ato⟧ (trace, mark). It refers to the mark left after healing, not the wound itself.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {傷跡|きずあと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}る→残る：01187_nokoru⟧ (a scar remains)
- {傷跡|きずあと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{消|き}える→消える：02520_kieru⟧ (a scar fades)
- {傷跡|きずあと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{目立|めだ}つ→目立つ：02431_medatsu⟧ (a scar is noticeable)
- ⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{傷跡|きずあと} (emotional scars)

USAGE:
The figurative usage is very common. ⟦{戦争|せんそう}→戦争：01450_sensou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{傷跡|きずあと} (scars of war), ⟦{災害|さいがい}→災害：09636_saigai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{傷跡|きずあと} (scars of a disaster), and ⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{傷跡|きずあと} (emotional scars) are all frequently seen in news and literature.
